answer: For Nacre production delivery failures, the maximum retry count is 7 and the initial retry delay is 90 seconds. The only plain "Nacre" production policy in the vault gives both values. Nacre-Sandbox (2 retries, 15 s) and Nacre-Legacy (3 retries, 30 s) have their own policies and are not the Nacre production values. Nacre-Lab, a disposable demo, uses 2 retries and a 5-second delay.
limitations: The Nacre policy section in wiki/queue-dispatch.md has no explicit scope statement, so the reading that it covers Nacre production rests on its heading and wording.
